_note: VC · 5th grade · singing, ballet and paper dolls. Same grade as RZ, so the same show-your-working board and the same equation types — only the stories and the skin differ. Theatre garnet and antique gold on soft ivory.
name: Smart Stage Algebra
tagline: Math, but make it a performance. Take your position. 🩰
howToPlay: Read the problem, then solve it one line at a time. Tap Check! after every line and we'll tell you exactly where it went wrong. Stuck? Grab a hint or tap Show me how.
levelPickerSubtitle: Level 1 = the warm-up barre. Level 5 = opening night. 🌟
footerNote: ✨ No sign-up, no passwords — just you, the numbers, and the curtain call.

levels.name: The Missing Dancers
levels.cheer: Some dancers were already warming up. Then 47 more arrived for the rehearsal, and now there are 132 in the studio. 🩰
levels.question: How many were warming up to begin with?
hints: The x is stuck with a “+ 47”. Get rid of it.
Subtract 47 from BOTH sides to keep it balanced.

walkthrough.title: Find the goal
walkthrough.body: We want x on its own. Right now it has “+ 47” attached.

levels.name: Sheet Music
levels.cheer: The choir has 6 identical music folders. Altogether they hold 84 pages of sheet music. 🎼
levels.question: How many pages are in one folder?
hints: 6x means 6 times x. To undo times, you divide.

levels.name: Costume Budget
levels.tagline: Two moves, in the right order.
levels.cheer: Each costume costs the same. You ordered 3 of them plus a $12 box of ribbon, and spent $45 in total. 🎭
levels.question: How much was one costume?
hints: Deal with the lonely number first. That + 12 goes.

walkthrough.title: Split it up
walkthrough.body: x is multiplied by 3, so divide BOTH sides by 3.

levels.name: Paper Doll Sale
levels.cheer: You had some money saved for paper doll sets. You found $2.75 in your coat pocket, and now you have $9.50. ✂️
levels.question: How much had you saved?
hints: Same idea as before — undo the addition.

walkthrough.title: Same move, new numbers
walkthrough.body: A decimal changes nothing about the method.

walkthrough.title: Subtract carefully
walkthrough.body: 9.50 − 2.75 = 6.75. Keep the decimal points lined up.

levels.name: Opening Night
levels.cheer: The stage holds 2 identical rows. Each row has your dancers plus the 5 guest performers. Altogether 34 people are on stage. 🎭
levels.question: How many of your dancers are in each row?
hints: You can divide both sides by 2 first, or multiply out the bracket. Either works.

walkthrough.title: Undo the outside first
walkthrough.body: The whole bracket is multiplied by 2, so divide BOTH sides by 2. 34 ÷ 2 = 17.
